systems.country_label: قاعدة بيانات السجل المدني / نظام السجل المدني
systems.owner: General Administration of Civil Registry, Ministry of Interior
systems.tiers: national database of more than 120 million records, holding the old nationality archive and the first Sudanese birth certificate of 1901; recovered electronically from Khartoum in 63 days to a secured data centre reached from Red Sea State, and the Khartoum copy encrypted and locked, as the registry's technology director states (published 2024-11-08; the recovery date is not given)

note: The document describes the recovery of the central civil registry database, without which identity could not be established nor e-passports or birth certificates for children born in the war issued; it does not say where or how a birth or death is entered, so the system is unclassified and gives no fact.
